Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring libraries to offer filtering software for minor access to the internet.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to internet access for patrons of public libraries;and adding a new section to chapter 27.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 27.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Where internetaccess library terminals are available for publicuse, libraries shall equip such terminals with filtering software thatblocks, to the extent technically possible, access to internet sitesthat are both adultoriented and sexually explicit. Members of thepublic shall not have access to such material on public librarycomputers. Library staff shall not monitor the use of internetaccessterminals in any way other than as directed by library policy or statelaw.
